slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
sharper than everyone around you

crosswords with coffee

do one crossword or word puzzle with your morning coffee. it wakes up your memory and your vocabulary before the busy day ahead has even properly started.

cooking without measuring

cook one meal a week without weighing anything, adjusting only by taste. it trains your attention, your judgement and your confidence in your own instincts.

one lesson a day

spend 5 minutes a day on how the world works: physics, the human body, the planets. understanding a little more each day makes you notice what others miss.
slides.texte_sophia:
one lesson a day

i spend 5 minutes a day on how the world works, like physics or the planets. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and i notice and understand so much more now.

slides.texte_overlay:
arguing the other side

once a week, pick a topic and defend the opinion you disagree with. understanding the other side properly makes your own thinking clearer and much sharper.

learning birdsong

learn to recognise the songs of five birds near your home. it trains your ears and your patience, and every walk outside becomes a small puzzle to solve.
